text: Welcome to the waiting room! Take a seat, leaf through a magazine … next, please!
That's you. Nobody else is here. My practice runs wonderfully tidy.
Dr. Dr. Möhrchen! Twice a doctor, once for real.
On the ranch it's called a paddock, here it's called a practice. The carrots are the same.
That's what I like to see! Prevention is the best care.
A carrot as a reward? Doctor's orders. For me. But I share.
Right, let's have a look. Onto the bench, please!
(He listens with a carrot. It is not a stethoscope, but it is orange.)
Say aaah. … A solid aaah. I have heard everything I wanted to hear.
Diagnosis: a classic case of too-much-or-too-little. Probably both.
Treatment plan is ready. What will it be?
(He patches Gooby up with ointment, a plaster and a carrot lollipop. Active ingredient: affection.)
The bill: 120 coins. The lollipop is on the house.
(He stamps ceremoniously. Twice on the prescription, once on his own forehead.)
Gooby Drops, twice a day. Hilde at the GOOBYTHEKE has them in stock.

rezept_schon.text: You already have one! Says here: Gooby Drops. My handwriting, my stamp, my forehead.

ruhe.text: Also good! Sleep is half the medicine. The other half is … well? Exactly. Carrots.

text: Aftercare: plenty of sleep, something healthy to eat, stay warm and clean.
And if the sneezing stays: I am here. With carrots.

checkup_frage.text: A check-up! Very sensible. 30 coins, ear-wiggle test included.

text: (He checks ears, tummy and floof. All by the book.)
Findings: adorable. Come back before anything twinges!
